name: Predator chains Sanguine Mend and raises two crit damage bonuses (#1669)
contract: Predator 300590 effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 15 (SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10%, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 2097152, 16384) = word 1 bit 21 (the Sanguine Rupture damage rows 800775, 802496) and word 2 bit 14 (Claw Sweep 500169, 500436-500441, 500444). Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS) and BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = +2, over (524288, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 19 = the nine Sanguine Mend records (504079-504086, 802310). Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets starts from ChainTarget 0, applies SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to reach 2 and chains to maxTargets - 1 = 1 extra ally. Tooltip: "Your Sanguine Mend now heals ${$m2-1} additional nearby target. Increases the critical damage of Claw Sweep and Sanguine Rupture by $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.
